biggest_catch: The $300 bonus is TARGETED — official terms say it is only for people who receive Langley's direct-mail promotion; without the mailer you will likely be denied the bonus.
catches: TARGETED OFFER: 'Offer available only to eligible recipients who receive this promotion directly from Langley through the new member acquisition direct mail campaign.' No mailer/email from Langley = no bonus.

Qualifying deposits must be payroll, pension, Social Security, or other recurring ACH income — transfers between Langley accounts, P2P payments, mobile deposits, ATM deposits, cash deposits, check deposits, and wire transfers do NOT qualify.
Must open the checking account within 30 days of the membership open date.
Account must stay open and in good standing through the reward payout date.
No expiration date is shown ('Limited-time offer') — terms can change or end without notice.
Bonuses are reported to the IRS; you owe tax on the reward.

c1.evidence: Official page headline: 'New Members Can Earn up To $300 with a Langley Checking Account'; terms: 'To qualify for the $300 checking reward, new and existing members who receive the promotional email directly from Langley must open a Langley Checking account within 30 days of membership open date, receive qualifying deposits of at least $1,000 each month for three consecutive months...'

c2.evidence: Langley Federal Credit Union is a real, operating federal credit union; the promo page states 'Federally insured by NCUA.'

c3.evidence: No upfront fee or purchase required to earn the bonus. Membership requires a $5 deposit into a Langley savings account (a refundable share deposit, not a fee).

c4.evidence: Exact payout quote below is verbatim from https://www.langleyfcu.org/get-rewarded (langleyfcu.org, the credit union's official domain).

eligibility: TARGETED: 'Offer available only to eligible recipients who receive this promotion directly from Langley through the new member acquisition direct mail campaign.' Must open a Langley Checking account within 30 days of membership open date; promo code LANGLEYBONUS2026 at account opening; limit one checking reward per eligible member; cannot be combined with other checking promotional offers; employees/volunteers/affiliates and their immediate family are ineligible. Langley membership requires a $5 savings deposit; Langley's official site states 'Anyone can be a Langley member, regardless of occupation or affiliation.'
notes: Verified against the live official promo page (langleyfcu.org/get-rewarded) on 2026-09-22 CDT. The $300 checking reward is real and concrete in official terms, but it is a targeted direct-mail acquisition offer — this is the single most important fact about this route and must be shown to users. A separate public referral offer ($50) exists but is not this route. No promo end date is published on the page. Checking-account monthly fee details are not on the promo page; the reward itself has no fee.

steps: Go to https://www.langleyfcu.org/get-rewarded and confirm you received Langley's direct-mail/email promotion (required — targeted offer).

Open a Langley membership with the $5 savings deposit, then open a Langley Checking account within 30 days of the membership open date, entering promo code LANGLEYBONUS2026 at account opening (account opening flow is at membership.langleyfcu.org, linked from the promo page).

Set up qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security, or other recurring ACH income — NOT P2P, mobile/ATM/cash/check deposits, or wires) of at least $1,000 in each of 3 consecutive months.
Keep the checking account open and in good standing through the reward payout date.
The $300 reward is deposited to your Langley savings account after the third consecutive qualifying month, once requirements are verified.
Report the $300 as taxable income (bonuses are reported to the IRS).
timing: Reward will be deposited into the member's Langley savings account after the third consecutive month of qualification and after all requirements have been verified.
